sources.title: kela.fi
highlights: When you move to Finland, you can usually qualify for benefits from Kela and a Kela card starting from the day of the move
Personal identity codes are issued by the Digital and Population Data Services Agency (dvv.fi
You must have a bank account so that we can pay your benefits to you
You must also have a residence permit granted by the Finnish Immigration Service (migri.fi) if you need one to stay or work in Finland before you can get benefits from Kela
If you cannot use OmaKela, send your application forms and form Moving to Finland or employment in Finland Y 77e (PDF) to Kela by mail

sources.title: kela.fi
highlights: You can apply for a Kela card either on a form or in the OmaKela e-service

Apply for a Kela card on the form Application Kela card SV 157e (PDF). Let us also know that you are moving to Finland with the form Notification - Moving to Finland or employment in Finland Y 77e (PDF
If you cannot get direct reimbursement at the private clinic, you can apply for it afterwards from Kela

sources.title: ihhelsinki.fi
highlights: To submit your applications to Kela, you can mail them and any necessary documents to: Kela, PL 10, 00056 KELA
